title: 基本面经营状态因子目录
research_notes: This catalog is a research map; it does not claim backtest performance.
Real calculations must use point-in-time financial observations keyed by available or disclosure date.
TTM must require four complete quarters; do not replace missing quarters with nanmean multiplied by four.
The standardized operating profit implementation must compare operating_profit_ttm with historical operating_profit_ttm, not quarterly operating_profit.
The local PIT vintage currently provides operate_profit and available_date; a faithful six-TTM factor still needs an explicit quarterly normalization contract.
